openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Wet residual outside. Charge inside. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Then own the board.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Checking is thin. The plan is not. Scenario D holds the line until the 23rd. Do not invent payments. Breath first. Body second. Security skim when ready. Money last. Competitors may arrive loud; you arrive prepared.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Residual weather outside; heat inside.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart. Smooth continuous reps. Optional: Front Clips / Back Clips.
